List shows friction entries, one line each: id, status (unless open), kind,
votes, age, who filed it, and the summary. Most votes first, then newest.
By default it lists open and accepted entries.

An entry linked to the same problem on another host ends with the links,
checked over the bus: [= #34@workstation], and a stale one is flagged, e.g.
[= #34@workstation !out of step] (agent friction show says what to run).

--status takes open, accepted, resolved, wontfix, duplicate, or all, or
several separated by commas.

Usage:
  agent friction list [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction list
  agent friction list --status all --kind help
  agent friction list --by lead --json

Flags:
      --by string       Only entries filed by this agent ("user" for people)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --json            Print as JSON
      --kind string     Only this kind
      --status string   open, accepted, resolved, wontfix, duplicate, all; comma-separated (default: list open,accepted; export all)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
